method: Verified complete task trace, unique same-Page three-mark clock calibration and renderer PID/TID. Only closed X spans are intervals; no pairing asynchronous b/e with synchronous B. Offset uncertainty propagated to possible and guaranteed overlap and unioned without double-counting nesting. Task wall spans and thread-duration fields are descriptive, not CPU self-time, idle evidence or causal attribution. Window excludes startup and uses previously qualified registered game RAF waits. Desktop artificial native-ABI touch only.
